title: Jio's IPO was booked 22 times. Institutions drove it, retail was the calmest
short: Jio's IPO was booked 22 times. Here's who bid
dek: Bids topped ₹7 lakh crore and nearly 1.4 crore applications came in. But almost all the oversubscription came from institutions, and mostly on the last day. Shares list on 28 October.
card: QIBs bid 70 times their quota, retail under 3 times. What the numbers say about allotment and listing day.
